acceptance.scope: Implementation parity for the unchanged accepted C8 model. External errors, adaptation outcomes and temporal counterfactual results are research measurements, not silently waived replacement-model gates.

configs/cycle10.json.adaptation: Nested subsets of 6 then 24 external adaptation games; revise only existing relative learner hypotheses using native revision and game/opening dependence. Final test never used for tuning or promotion.
configs/cycle10.json.calibration: Ten strength bins, Laplace smoothing; fit external calibration games only after frozen evaluation. 400 deterministic game-cluster bootstrap replicates.
configs/cycle10.json.frozen: Evaluate unchanged C8 checkpoint and Cycle 9 calibration on every external position before any external adaptation or calibration fitting.
configs/cycle10.json.git_policy: Local commits only; no push or deployment.
configs/cycle10.json.leakage: Exclude historical and cross-game whole-position translation, reflection and color-swap equivalents; audit exact FEN and four-field canonical hashes. Shared local relational features are not independent knowledge.
configs/cycle10.json.native_composition: No new operator; architecture review only.
configs/cycle10.json.opening_partition: SHA256 ECO three-character family, or first four-ply sequence when absent; modulo 5: 0 adaptation, 1 calibration, otherwise final test. Shared opening-family assignment across sources.
configs/cycle10.json.selection: First 1000 valid complete standard game records per source, deterministic game-content hash order; retain earliest eligible games meeting preregistered split quotas. Position sampling spreads across the complete record, augmented by objectively defined special-move/endgame opportunities before any model evaluation.

configs/cycle3.json.induction: Controlled experimental alternative; no benefit assumed
configs/cycle3.json.training: Cycle 2 eligible short-ray examples plus 48 independent contact positions

configs/cycle4.json.composition: Learned unary constraint chains. No conjunction implementation or claim. Local positive projection explicitly remains non-compositional.
configs/cycle4.json.induction_task: Withhold a local distance subgroup, estimate explicit A/B/C marginals on independent training groups, test native induced conditional activation on the withheld subgroup. No test-selected thresholds.
configs/cycle4.json.registration: Fixed before generating or evaluating the Cycle 4 independent holdout. Frozen C2/C3 sets are retrospective regressions, never training inputs.
configs/cycle4.json.training: Cycle 3 training records only; local outcome uses auxiliary pseudo-legal label. Independent attack/exposure/legality pools retained.

configs/cycle5.json.induction: Experimental only. Generate a bounded candidate relation from training descriptors and measured populations, with no pre-supplied consequent rule; compare disabled and sham controls, report local and global effects separately.
configs/cycle5.json.policy: C5-strict: retain supported native negative proofs; positive local projections remain diagnostic, and incomplete global composition yields unknown.
configs/cycle5.json.registration: Locked before Cycle 5 fixture generation and learner changes. C2-C4 holdouts are retrospective regressions, never new training data.
configs/cycle5.json.training: Frozen C4 labels plus a separately audited premise-only factorial curriculum; holdout combinations excluded from the latter. C4 prior overlap is reported separately.

configs/cycle6.json.promotion: Only a matching acceptance.json with every required executed check can select operational by default.

configs/cycle7.json.evaluation_budget_reason: The development full-budget pilot exhausted the shared 20000-node cap on one two-stage position. All canonical offline arms use 100000; production remains 20000.
configs/cycle7.json.promotion: Zero observed errors on all locked suites and no worse C6/new-game recall and exact sets; otherwise frozen C6 source remains default.
configs/cycle7.json.selection: missing exact local rule first, then structural novelty; labels hidden until selection

configs/cycle8-replay.json.scope: Pre-clean-run deterministic replay sentinels; no selection based on held-out outcomes.

configs/cycle8.json.calibration: Offline validation-fit empirical diagnostics only; never alter native truth values or classification.
configs/cycle8.json.candidate_policy: Preserve frozen supported decisions; use C7 exact learned categories and separately trained promotion transitions only for unresolved candidates. Never drop destination occupancy from the candidate projection.
configs/cycle8.json.git_policy: Local commits only; no push or external publication.
configs/cycle8.json.holdout_policy: Structural-combination and adversarial families are distinct from training families. No exact/symmetry/translation lineage or game overlap. Shared reusable local subrelations are measured explicitly.
configs/cycle8.json.promotion_gate: All established and new acceptance suites: zero observed false-legal, false-illegal, self-check and incomplete results; no loss of prior supported decisions or recall/exact sets; all negative controls, source boundaries, native parity, cache parity, clean bootstrap and tests pass. Otherwise retain C7-frozen.
configs/cycle8.json.promotion_scope: Partial learned local transition; existing native exposure chains remain separate.
configs/cycle8.json.selection_order: Evaluate both preregistered candidates on every suite. Prefer the promotion-relative candidate if all gates pass; otherwise consider the exact-only no-promotion candidate under the same gates; otherwise preserve C7-frozen. No destructive ablation is eligible.

configs/cycle9.json.calibration: Fit ten-bin Laplace-smoothed strength-to-legality frequency on calibration games; evaluate once on independent heldout opening families. Diagnostic only.
configs/cycle9.json.game_stop: Natural python-chess automatic termination, including fivefold repetition and 75-move draws; no ply cap accepted as a complete game.
configs/cycle9.json.git_policy: Local commits only. No push or external deployment.
configs/cycle9.json.native_composition: Review only; no new operator or repeated exhausted probes.
configs/cycle9.json.optimization: Investigate redundant immutable model serialization without changing proof payloads or native arithmetic.
configs/cycle9.json.sampling: Five nonterminal positions spread across the completed game, excluding all historical and cross-split translated/reflected board equivalents.
configs/cycle9.json.temporal: Versioned diagnostic receipt, explicitly separate observed transitions, trusted state metadata and inferred conditions.
configs/cycle9.json.training: No new operational training. One development-only evidence reuse study; final heldout data cannot change hypotheses or thresholds.

configs/runtime-lock.json.atomspace: PeTTa native in-process MeTTa space (no Hyperon AtomSpace dependency)
